dependencies.name: Opus
dependencies.note: LOWER RISK: prefer official stable vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH tags rather than main/development commits or relying only on GitHub Releases. The 439 source files shared with the vendored subset match upstream v1.6.1 exactly. When updating, retain app-specific source selection, CMake/build configuration, and project packaging files; do not import the entire upstream tree blindly.

dependencies.name: TizenAmbilight (Ambilight service)
dependencies.baseline_label: Monitoring baseline established 2026-11-09; GitHub mirror master HEAD (2026-10-25)
dependencies.note: HIGH RISK: our ambilight-service is a Moonlight/AppControl-specific adaptation of this project, not a drop-in copy. The upstream GitLab project (https://gitlab.com/ritwick7/TizenAmbilight) is mirrored to GitHub master. Review upstream changes selectively, especially VideoPlaneCapture.cs, WledOutput.cs, Program.cs and related capture/processing modules. Preserve our AppControl lifecycle, Moonlight integration, Tizen target/packaging, 32-bit constraints and local validation. Never replace the service directory or individual files wholesale; port only verified fixes and update this monitoring baseline only after review.
